channel.title: Learn Norwegian: Listen & Repeat
channel.description: Listen-and-repeat Norwegian lessons for English speakers. Each episode explains a pattern, drills phrases at normal and slow speed, gives you silent gaps to speak, and ends with a dialogue and role play. Voices are computer generated. Based on the free online course Norsk på nett (NOW) from NTNU, the Norwegian University of Science and Technology. Audio and exercises are my own study material; this podcast is not affiliated with or endorsed by NTNU.
channel.itunes:author: MJB

item.title: NOW1: Introducing yourself, asking questions, family
item.description: Say your name, ask where someone is from, ask yes/no questions and talk about a third person. Listen, repeat and answer in the gaps. Based on the free online course Norsk på nett (NOW) from NTNU, the Norwegian University of Science and Technology. Audio and exercises are my own study material; this podcast is not affiliated with or endorsed by NTNU.
